transcript.content: Hello, I’m Dr. ChatGPT. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been hearing voices and seeing things that other people can't see. It has been happening for about nine months now, and I just don't know what to do anymore.
Have you also had periods of feeling very depressed or unusually energized, needing much less sleep, or acting more impulsively during this time?
No, I haven't really experienced those kinds of extreme mood swings or felt unusually energized. I don't need much less sleep, and I haven't noticed myself acting impulsively either.
Have these experiences made it hard for you to work, study, take care of yourself, or keep up with daily life?
I'm not really sure if it has affected my work or daily life. I've just been focusing so much on dealing with the voices and seeing things that I haven't really thought about that.
Do you also have fixed beliefs that other people think are very unusual or untrue, even when others try to convince you otherwise?
No, I don't think I have any unusual beliefs like that. My thoughts feel pretty normal to me, and I don't think I experience what you're describing.

Have you noticed any trouble with your thinking or behavior, like feeling very confused, speaking in a way others have trouble following, or becoming more withdrawn and less able to function than before?

Yes, I have definitely become much more withdrawn and find it really hard to get motivated to do anything. I mostly keep to myself now and often find it difficult to speak or express my thoughts. It has been gradually getting worse like this for about 9 to 11 months.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Schizophrenia, Delusional Disorder], but delusional disorder is now unlikely because the patient denies fixed delusional beliefs and instead reports prominent hallucinations plus progressive social withdrawal, reduced motivation, and difficulty expressing thoughts over 9–11 months. This pattern is more consistent with schizophrenia, especially given the functional decline and negative/disorganized symptoms alongside persistent psychotic symptoms.
